about: The Ethiopians rejoice and set Zion upon a cart; the idols of Egypt fall, the Red Sea quakes, bows to her while its creatures and birds honour her, and they go on past Sinai, Kadesh and Midian to Ethiopia. Then Zadok returns to Solomon, who tells his dream of the sun that left Judah for Ethiopia, and Zadok opens the sanctuary and finds only boards where Zion stood.

sentences.l: And-they-took-up harps and-they-blew horn and-drum and-ብዕዛ (?), and at-voice-of their-song and-their-joy was-stirred and-resounded river-of Egypt, and-they-joined with-them ውውዓ (?) and-song;
sentences.i: And they took up harps and blew the horn and drum and the bəʿza (?); and at the sound of their song and their joy the river of Egypt was stirred and resounded, and they joined with them in ውውዓ (?) and song;
sentences.n: ወአኀዙ 'and they began / took hold' (አኀዘ + plural), with ዕንዚራተ 'harps' in the accusative (-ተ). ቀርነ 'horn' and ከበሮ 'drum' (the -ሮ is not a suffix). ብዕዛ is UNCERTAIN: I take it as another musical instrument, but I cannot say which. In ወበቃለ ማሕሌቶሙ the construct ቃለ 'voice-of' governs the chain; ተሀውከት (stirred, T-stem of ሀወከ) and ደምፀት (resounded) are 3rd feminine singular, agreeing with ፈለገ ግብጽ 'river-of Egypt', most likely the Nile (?). The feminine verbs sit beside masculine ፈለግ; they agree rather with ግብጽ, a feminine country-name (?). ወኀብሩ 'and they joined' has no stated subject (the Egyptians? ?); ውውዓ is UNCERTAIN, perhaps a cry or shout of acclamation. ፤ ends the unit.

sentences.l: And-fell their-idols which they-made with-their-hands, likeness-of man and-dog and-cat, and-also ማኅፈደ ነዋኃት (?) and-those with-them, likeness-of eagles of-gold and-silver, fell and-were-shattered;
sentences.i: And their idols fell, which they had made with their hands in the likeness of man and dog and cat; and also the tall towers (?) and the images of eagles, of gold and silver, that were with them fell and were shattered;
sentences.n: ጣዖታቲሆሙ 'their idols' (ጣዖት + plural -ት + ሆሙ). ዘገብሩ 'which they made'; አምሳለ is the construct 'likeness-of', so አምሳለ ሰብእ ወከልብ ወድመት is 'likeness of man and dog and cat'. ማኅፈደ ነዋኃት is UNCERTAIN: I take ማኅፈድ as 'tower, turret' and ነዋኃት as the plural of ነዊሕ 'tall', giving 'tall towers'; the phrase could be something else. ወእለ ምስሌሆሙ 'and those with them' is loose, and I read it as the eagle-images set beside the idols (?). ተቀጥቀጡ is the T-stem of ቀጥቀጠ 'crush, shatter'. The idols falling before the Ark recalls 1 Samuel 5, where Dagon falls before the Ark.

sentences.i: for she shines like the sun, and they tremble at the terror of her;
sentences.n: The 'she' is Zion, the Ark (ታቦት). ታበርህ is the causative አብርሀ 'cause to shine' (3rd feminine imperfect), which in Geʿez is the ordinary verb 'shine'. ግርማ 'awe, terror' with ሃ 'her'; እም- 'from' gives the cause of the trembling; ይደነግፁ 'they are terrified' (ደንገፀ). ከመ ፀሐይ 'like the sun' likens Zion to the sun, as in chapter 54, and prepares the sun image of the dream in chapter 56.

sentences.l: And-they-clothed-her her-garments, and-they-bore her-fringe(?) before-her, and-they-set-her upon cart, having-spread cloth(?) beneath-her and-having-ፀፊሮሙ (?) cloth(?) above-her; and they-sing song before-her and-behind-her.
sentences.i: They clothed her in her garments and carried her fringe (?) before her, and set her upon a cart, with cloth (?) spread beneath her and cloth (?) draped (?) above her; and they sang a song before her and behind her.
sentences.n: ወአልበስዋ 'and they clothed her' (causative of ለበሰ, with ዋ 'her') and አልባሲሃ 'her garments'. ሞጻ is UNCERTAIN: the same word is in the chapter 56 heading (spelled ሞፃ). Here it follows 'they bore (ጾሩ) ... before her', so some object carried in procession. Chapters 51–52 render it 'hem, fringe (?)' (the keepsake Zadok is to bring with Zion's garment), and I keep that house reading: 'her fringe (?)', with ሃ 'her'. አንበርዋ 'they set her' (causative of ነበረ 'sit'). ነጺፎሙ ... ፀፊሮሙ are gerund forms with -ሙ ('they having spread ... having ...'); the second verb is UNCERTAIN: I take ፀፈረ as 'weave, plait, drape'. ሜላተ is an obscure word for something spread or laid, perhaps a covering (?) (as in the published parts; ch. 29 leaves it untranslated), here in the accusative. ታሕቴሃ 'beneath her' and በመልዕልቴሃ 'above her' have the suffix ሃ. ይሔልዩ is a plural imperfect used for continuing action, 'they sing'. ሰረገላ here is the vehicle carrying the Ark, rendered 'cart' as in chapters 30 and 49–53.

sentences.l: And-arose the-carts-also as formerly and-journeyed in-morning, while they-sing to-her, and-were-lifted-up all-of-them to-the-measure-of a-cubit;
sentences.i: And the carts too rose as before and set out in the morning, while they sang to her, and all of them were lifted up the measure of a cubit;
sentences.n: ሰረገላትኒ 'the carts, also': ሰረገላት is the plural, and the enclitic -ኒ adds 'also / indeed'. ከመ ቀዲሙ 'as formerly'. ጌሡ 'they journeyed' (ጌሠ). እንዘ ይሔልዩ ... 'while they sing' is a circumstantial clause (እንዘ + imperfect). ላቲ is ለ- + ቲ 'to her'. ተላዐሉ 'were raised' (T-stem of ላዐለ), a miracle: the travellers or carts rode a cubit above the ground (meaning ambiguous, since ኵሎሙ 'all of them' is masculine plural). መጠነ እመት 'to-the-measure-of a cubit' (construct; a cubit is roughly half a metre).

sentences.l: while they-escort-them (?) the-men-of land-of Egypt, they-passed before-them like shadow, and-bowed to-them the-men-of land-of Egypt, for they-saw-her while she-runs like sun in-the-midst-of heaven;
sentences.i: while the men of Egypt escorted them (?), they passed before them like a shadow; and the men of Egypt bowed down to them, for they saw her running like the sun in the midst of heaven;
sentences.n: ያስተፉንውዎሙ is UNCERTAIN: a causative-reflexive of ፈነወ 'send', so 'send them off / escort them' (?); the Egyptians might instead be supplying them. ሰብአ ብሔረ ግብጽ is a double construct chain, 'men-of land-of Egypt'. ከመ ጽላሎት 'like a shadow' describes the speed of passing. ሰገዱ ሎሙ 'they bowed to them' (ሎሙ = ለ- + ሙ). ርእይዋ 'they saw her' (ርእየ + ዋ); ትረውጽ 'she runs' (ሮጸ), with the Ark as subject, and እንዘ gives the circumstance. በውስተ ሰማይ 'in the midst of heaven'. The Egyptians' homage to the Ark echoes the fall of the idols (unit 2).

sentences.n: Exodus 14, the crossing of the sea. ባሕረ አልአሕመር is Arabic al-aḥmar 'the red', so 'Red Sea'; ባሕረ ኢርትራ is the Greek 'Erythraean' ('red') sea. እንተ ይእቲ 'which is' equates the two names. ተሠጥቀት 'was split' (T-stem of ሠጠቀ), feminine to agree with ባሕር; በእደ ሙሴ 'by the hand of Moses'. ኬዱ 'they walked'. ዐቀበ ወቊልቊለ is UNCERTAIN: I read ዐቀብ 'ascent' and ቊልቊል 'descent' as accusatives of manner, 'up and down' (the sea-floor uneven). For ጠግዐ ማይ, ጠግዐ is UNCERTAIN, perhaps 'thickened, stood firm' (compare Exodus 15:8 where the waters 'congealed'). አረፍትበይምን is printed as one word and is a fusion of አረፍት + በይምን, 'x on the right' (ይምን = right, የማን); አረፍት is UNCERTAIN, 'sides / walls (?)' (it recurs in the last unit). ወአረፍት በፅግም is the matching 'and x on the left' (ፅግም = ፀጋም 'left'); the second አረፍት is separated by a ፡ here, which confirms the split. ኢተውህበት 'was not given' is the T-passive of ወሀበ, 3rd feminine, with ታቦተ ሕጉ as its subject in the -ä form (?). Chapters 17–20 also read አረፍት as 'wall' (?). The reason clause (the Ark not yet given to Moses) explains why the sea needed the Ark's help. ወአኅለፎሙ 'and he made them pass' is the causative of ኀለፈ, with God as the unstated subject; ለእስራኤል repeats the object. እንስሳሆሙ 'their flocks / animals'.

sentences.i: And when holy Zion crossed, with those of hers who were then with her, singing a song with lyre and with harps, the sea too received them; its waves quaked as when tall mountains are shattered, and, like the voice of a lion that roars, so it resounded, loudly (?); and, like the thunder of the rainy season of Damascus and Ethiopia when lightning strikes the clouds, so it thundered; and the thunder joined with the harps, and the sea too bowed down to her;
sentences.n: One long sentence with no inner ፤, kept whole. ተዐዱ 'crossed' (T-stem of ዐደወ; an odd form, as noted at ch. 17–20, where a regular 3rd plural perfect would be ተዐደዉ, so the parse is uncertain) is plural in sense though ጽዮን is feminine singular; it takes in her company, ምስለ እሊአሃ አሜሃ እንተ ኀቤሃ 'with those of hers then, who (were) with her'. መሰንቆ 'lyre' and ዕንዚራት 'harps'. ተቀበለቶሙ 'she received them' (ተቀበለት 3rd feminine singular, the sea ባሕር as subject, + ሙ 'them'); ባሕርኒ 'the sea also'. ታንፈርዕጽ 'it quaked' is a quadriliteral reflexive (?); መዋግዲሃ 'its waves'. ሶበ ይትበተኩ 'when they are shattered'. አድባር ነዋኃት 'tall mountains' (አድባር = ደብር plural). The similes follow ከመ 'like': ድምፀ አንበሳ 'voice-of lion', ዘይጥሕር 'which roars'. በገንሕ is UNCERTAIN: I guess 'loudly / fiercely' (?). ነጐድጓደ ክረምተ 'thunder-of the rainy season' is a double construct; ደማስቆ is Damascus. ይዘብጦን 'it strikes them' (feminine plural suffix -ሆን), ዘብጠ 'strike'; ታንጐደጒድ 'it thunders'. ኀብረ is the verb 'joined', with the thunder as subject (not a noun-chain here). The sea does homage as the Egyptians did (unit 6).

sentences.n: ይትሀወክ 'is shaken' (T-stem of ሀወከ, as in unit 1). ተለዐለ 'was raised' is singular though ሰረገላቲሆሙ ('their carts', plural + ሆሙ) is plural, a loose agreement kept as printed. ፫ is the numeral 3, standing as its own word between ፡ marks (the build will treat it as a number: spoken ሠለስቱ). መልዕልተ መዋግድ 'above the waves' (construct). ዜማ 'melody'. ተላህያ is UNCERTAIN: it recurs three times in units 11–12, each time ending ተላህያ ለባሕር, and I cannot parse it. I take it as a noun, 'delight (?)', 'a delight to the sea', because in the next unit the adjectives ግሩም, መድምም, ዐዚዝ, ዕፁብ need something to qualify and ለባሕር is a dative; a verb 'was enchanted' would leave them without a subject. The sense is only a guess from context. It is printed as one word and is not corrected. መንክር 'marvelous' modifies ዜማ.

sentences.n: The two adjective pairs ግሩም ... መድምም and ዐዚዝ ... ዕፁብ ('awesome / astonishing', 'mighty / wondrous') are all praise of the song's effect; for ተላህያ see the note on unit 11 (UNCERTAIN, rendered as the noun 'delight (?)', with the adjectives qualifying it). ወእለ ውስቴታሂ አራዊት 'and those within it, the beasts': ውስቴታሂ is ውስቴታ + ሂ 'also / indeed'. ይትዐወቁ 'they are known' (T-stem of ዐወቀ). ወእለ ኢያስተርእዩ is UNCERTAIN: ያስተርእዩ is the causative-reflexive of ርእየ 'show / appear', so 'those which do not appear (?)', meaning unseen creatures of the deep; the ወ belongs to እለ (ወእለ ኢያስተርእዩ 'and those who do not ...'). ይወፅኡ 'they come out' and ይሰግዱ ላቲ 'they bow to her'. አዕዋፍኒ 'the birds also'. ይጠፍሑ 'they spread out' (ጠፍሐ, as in ch. 53) and ይጼልልዋ 'they shade her' (ጸለለ + ዋ). Sea creatures worshipping the Ark is a Psalm 148 motif ('sea monsters ... praise').

sentences.i: And there was joy for the Erythraean Sea and for the Ethiopians; and they came out of the sea and rejoiced even more than Israel when they came out of Egypt; and they reached the place opposite Mount Sinai and encamped at Kadesh. And there too, while the angels praised, the spiritual ones joined their praise with the sons of the earthly, in song and in psalm, with drum and rejoicing.
sentences.n: One long unit, kept whole (no inner ፤). ወኮነ ፍሥሓ 'and there was joy'. ወወፅኡ ባሕረ 'they came out [of] the sea' (ባሕረ is accusative). ተፈሥሑ ፈድፋደ እምነ እስራኤል 'rejoiced exceedingly more than Israel', the comparison with Exodus 14–15, the Song of the Sea. They then retrace Israel's route: አንጻረ ደብረ ሲና 'opposite Mount Sinai' (Exodus 19) and ቃዴስ Kadesh (Numbers 20, Kadesh-barnea). ወበህየኒ 'and there also'. ይሴብሑ 'they praise' (ሴበሐ) and ያኀብሩ 'they join' (causative of ኀብረ). መንፈሳዊያን 'spiritual ones' (angels) and መሬታዊያን 'earthly ones' (men) are adjectives made nouns; ደቂቀ መሬታዊያን is a construct, 'children-of the earthly'. ትፍሥሕት 'rejoicing'. The author makes the angelic liturgy and the earthly one one chorus; the unit ends at ። with no ፤ to cut.

sentences.i: And when Zadok the priest returned to King Solomon and found him troubled, the king answered Zadok the priest and said to him: When the queen came, this appeared to me in the night, as though I stood in the ቀመራ (?) of Jerusalem: the sun came down from heaven into the land of Judah and shone exceedingly; then, having lingered (?), it set, and shone upon the land of Ethiopia, and did not return again to the land of Judah;
sentences.n: ሶበ ገብአ 'when he returned'; ወረከቦ 'and found him' (ረከበ + ዎ). እንዘ ይቴክዝ 'while he is troubled' (T-stem of ከዘ, 'to grieve'). አውሥኦ 'he answered him' (አውሥአ + ዎ) with the king as subject. ይቤሎ 'said to him'. አመ ትመጽእ ንግሥት: አመ 'when' with the imperfect ትመጽእ 'she comes', the time of the queen's visit; the tense is ambiguous and I read it as past in the dream's frame. አስተርአየኒ 'appeared to me' (ኒ = 'me'). ከመዝ 'thus'. ከመ ዘእቀውም 'as one who I stand' (ዘ + 1st singular imperfect), 'as though I stood'. ቀመራ is UNCERTAIN: a place or feature of Jerusalem where he stands (a height, a wall-top, ?). ብሔረ ይሁዳ 'land-of Judah'. ፀሐይ takes masculine verbs here (ወረደ, ወአብርሃ) and then feminine ones (ዐረበት, ወአብርሀት, ወኢገብአት: 'set, shone, did not return'). ጐንዲያ is, as in ch. 30, the feminine gerund of ጐንደየ 'linger, delay' (?), 'having lingered', agreeing with the sun as subject of ዐረበት 'set'. ለብሔረ ኢትዮጵያ marks 'the land of Ethiopia' as the object of ወአብርሀት 'shone upon'. This is the sun-dream: the sun that leaves Judah for Ethiopia stands for the glory (Zion/the Ark) that goes with Menelik. The unit is long (44 words) but has no inner ፤.

sentences.i: And again the sun came down from heaven into the land of Judah and shone more brightly than before; and Israel set itself against it (?) and wished to cover its light; and it rose from beneath the earth, from where they had not expected, and shone upon the land of Rome and the land of Ethiopia, and after it upon all those who believed in him.
sentences.n: ካዕበ 'again'. እምቀዲሙ 'than before' (the comparative እም-). ተሀየይዎ is UNCERTAIN in sense: it looks like the 3rd masculine plural perfect of ተሀየየ (ch. 30 ተሀየዮሙ 'he turned away from them, or was angry with them (?)'; ch. 54 ወኢትትሀየዪ 'do not be slack (?)') with ዎ 'him/it' as object and Israel as the subject; here some hostile or contemptuous act (they turned against it, opposed it, ?). ፈቀዱ ይድፍኑ 'they wished to cover' (ደፈነ 'cover, shut in'; the same stem as ተደፍነ in unit 23). ብርሃኖ 'its light' (ዎ is masculine 'his / its', so the light is also read as 'his light'). ወሠረቀ 'and it rose' (ሠረቀ is the verb for sunrise). እንተ መትሕተ ምድር 'that beneath the earth'. ኢተሐዘብዎ 'they did not reckon it' (ተሐዘበ 'think, expect'). ሮሜ 'Rome' stands for the nations. እለ አምኑ ቦቱ 'those who believed in him' (ቦቱ masculine). The theology (a traditional reading, as at ch. 30; the passage itself only says 'sun'): the sun is taken as Christ (and the Ark/Zion), refused by Israel, rising among the nations and Ethiopia; the reader should hear the Christian light-imagery (Malachi 4:2, John 1) here.

sentences.i: In truth it was holy Zion, the likeness of the sun, who appeared to me then, while I lay asleep with the queen of Ethiopia;
sentences.n: በአማን 'in truth'. አምሳሊሃ ለፀሐይ 'the likeness of the sun': the suffix ሃ anticipates the owner, ለፀሐይ, so ጽዮን ቅድስት 'holy Zion' is the one named. ዘአስተርአየኒ 'who appeared to me'. እንዘ ሀሎኩ ንዉምየ 'while I was asleep': ሀሎኩ 'I was', ንዉም 'asleep' + የ, which is printed as if 'my asleep' (a suffix that behaves like 'I'). ምስለ ንግሥተ ኢትዮጵያ 'with the queen of Ethiopia', the Queen of Sheba (Makeda). The source says 'then': the dream is dated to the night he lay with her.

sentences.n: The spelling here is ሰዶቅ, against ሳዶቅ earlier; the source prints both (a spelling variation, kept as printed). አልቦ 'there is not', used here as 'no'. እግዚኦ 'O lord' (vocative -ኦ). ፫ is the numeral 3, standing as its own word before ልብስ (the build reads it as ሠለስቱ 'three'); ልብስ is singular in form, 'garment', with the number. በኀቤሃ 'from beside her'. ነሣእኩ 'I took' (1st singular). ወአልበስክዋ 'I clothed her'. ወሀብከኒ 'you gave me'. ወአምጻእኩ 'I brought' (አምጽአ 'bring'). sentences.i: And Zadok the priest took the keys, and went and opened the gates of the house of the sanctuary; and he hastened to look and to search, and he found nothing except firm (?) boards (?) of wood at the sides (?) of Zion's seat (?), which Azariah had made as her likeness (?).
sentences.n: The spelling is ሰዶቅ again. መራኁተ 'keys' (accusative, plural of መርኆ). ኀዋኅወ ቤተ መቅደስ 'gates-of house-of sanctuary' (double construct). አፍጠነ ነጽሮ ወኀሢሠ 'he hastened to look and to search' (infinitives). ወአልቦ ዘረከበ 'and there is not what he found'. ዕፀወ ለውሕ ጥጉዓን is UNCERTAIN in each word: ዕፀወ is the plural of ዕፅ 'wood' (or the construct), ለውሕ may be 'tablet / board' (?), ጥጉዓን may mean 'firm, solid' (?, compare ጠግዐ in unit 8, 'congealed'). በአረፍተ ምንባሪሃ is UNCERTAIN: አረፍት 'sides / edges' (?, recurring from unit 8) and ምንባር 'seat, place of sitting' (?) with ሃ 'her'; ለጽዮን names her. ዘአስተማሰለ አዛርያስ 'who made-the-likeness, Azaryas': አስተማሰለ is the causative-reflexive of ማሰለ 'be like', 'made a copy', and ዘ- is the relative; Azaryas is Zadok's son (ch. 43, 45), who in ch. 45 had boards made to stand in for Zion; the house English is 'Azariah'. So the king's dream is confirmed: the real Zion is gone and only a copy's boards remain. Five ፨ close the chapter, kept on this unit.

glossary.ወእምሂየ: ህየ — and from there (ወ- + እም- + adverb ህየ 'there', printed with extra -ሂ)
glossary.ወእምድኅሬሁ: ድኅረ — and after him (ወ- 'and' + እም- 'from' + preposition with 3ms suffix -ሁ)
glossary.ወእምግርማሃ: ግርማ — and from her awe, terror (ወ- + እም- 'from' + noun + -ሃ '3fs her')
glossary.ወከመ: ከመ — that, so that (conjunction; ወ- 'and') · and as (ወከመ ዝ 'and as this') · 'and like' before a noun (ወከመ ድምፀ አንበሳ 'and like the voice of a lion')
glossary.ወኬዱ: ከይደ — and they walked (ወ- + 3mp perfect, G; spelled ኬዱ, as ኬደ in ch. 24)
glossary.ወኮነ: ኮነ — and it was, became (ወ- + 3m sg perfect)
glossary.ወኵሎሙ: ኵሉ — and all of them, and all (ወ- + ኵሉ + -ሙ '3mp')
glossary.ወወሀቦ: ወሀበ — and he gave him (ወ- + 3ms perfect, w-h-b + -ኦ 'him')
glossary.ወወድቁ: ወድቀ — and they fell (ወ- + 3mp perfect, G)
glossary.ወወፅኡ: ወጽአ — and they came out (ወ- + 3mp perfect, G)
glossary.ወዓዲ: ዓዲ — and still, also, moreover (ወ- + adverb)
glossary.ወዕፁብ: ዕፁብ — and hard, difficult (ወ- + adjective) · 'and wondrous, marvellous' (ወዕፁብ ተላህያ ለባሕር 'and wondrous was the delight (?) for the sea', ch. 55)
glossary.ወያኀብሩ: አኀበረ — and they join (ወ- + 3mp imperfect, causative of ኀብረ)
glossary.ወይሔልዩ: ሐለየ — and they sing (ወ- + 3mp imperfect, G; ሐለየ 'meditate, sing')
glossary.ወይሰግዱ: ሰገደ — and they will bow down (ወ- + 3mp imperfect, s-g-d)
glossary.ወይቤሎ: ብህለ — and he said to him (ወ- 'and' + 3ms perfect ይቤ of b-h-l + -ሎ 'to him')
glossary.ወይጼልልዋ: ጸለለ — and they shade her (ወ- + 3mp imperfect + -ዋ 'her')
glossary.ወደምፀት: ደምፀ — and it sounded, resounded (ወ- + 3fs perfect, d-m-ṣ; subject ሀገር) (?) · subject also ፈለገ ግብጽ 'river of Egypt' (ch. 55)
glossary.ወደቂቆሙ: ደቂቅ — and their children (ወ- + noun, plural + -ሙ '3mp their')
glossary.ወጌሡ: ጌሠ — and they journeyed (ወ- + 3mp perfect ጌሡ; lemma ጌሠ 'go, travel') (?)
glossary.ወጐንዲያ: ጐንደየ — and having lingered (?) (ወ- + gerund, 3fs, of ጐንደየ 'linger, delay'; as ጐንዲያ in ch. 30) (?)
glossary.ወጾሩ: ጾረ — and they bore, carried (ወ- + 3mp perfect, G)
glossary.ወፀፊሮሙ: ፀፈረ — and they having plaited, draped (?) (ወ- + 3mp gerund in -ሙ, G; sense of ፀፈረ uncertain) (?)
glossary.ወፈቀዱ: ፈቀደ — and they wished (ወ- + 3mp perfect, G)
glossary.ወፈትሐ: ፈትሐ — and he loosened, opened (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G)
glossary.ወፍሥሓሆሙ: ፍሥሓ — and their joy (ወ- + noun + -ሆሙ '3mp their')
glossary.ውሂቦ: ውሂብ — his giving (verbal noun of ወሀበ + -ዎ 'his')
glossary.ውስተ: ውስተ — in, within, into · to, among (ወለአከ ውስተ ኵሉ ነጋድያን 'and he sent to all the merchants') · at (ውስተ መድረከ ኆኃቲሃ 'at the threshold of her doors')
glossary.ውስቴታሂ: ውስተ — within it also (noun/preposition ውስቴታ + enclitic -ሂ 'also, indeed')
glossary.ውውዓ: ውውዓ — ውውዓ (?) (unidentified noun; the context suggests a shout or acclamation, as in ch. 38–39 በውውዓ) (?)
glossary.ዐረበት: ዐረበ — she set (of the sun) (3fs perfect, G)
glossary.ዐቀበ: ዐቀብ — ascent, rising ground (?) (noun, accusative of manner; form ዐቀበ, reading uncertain) (?)
glossary.ዕንዚራተ: ዕንዚራ — harp (noun, a stringed instrument; 'harp' by convention, ch. 38–39 leave it as 'perhaps a harp or lyre'; accusative plural ዕንዚራተ 'harps')
glossary.ዕንዚራት: ዕንዚራ — harps (noun, plural ዕንዚራት; a stringed instrument, see ዕንዚራተ)
glossary.ዕፀወ: ዕፅ — trees (plural ዕፀው, accusative) · construct 'planks, pieces of wood of' (ዕፀወ ለውሕ, ch. 56) (?)
glossary.ዘረከበ: ረከበ — what he found (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect, G)
glossary.ዘርኢከ: ርእየ — which you saw (ዘ- relative + 2ms perfect, G)
glossary.ዘቃማ: ቃማ (?) — ዘቃማ (?) (ዘ- + ቃማ; ቃማ also in ch. 51–52 (ወቃማ), 'something of gold'; meaning not established) (?)
glossary.ዘተፈሥሑ: ተፈሥሐ — that which rejoiced, how they rejoiced (ዘ- relative + 3mp perfect, tä-stem of ፈሥሐ)
glossary.ዘአስተማሰለ: አስተማሰለ — who made the likeness (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect, causative-reflexive of ማሰለ)
glossary.ዘአስተርአየኒ: አስተርአየ — what was shown to me, what appeared to me (ዘ- + 3ms perfect, Ct + -ኒ 'to me') · 'who appeared to me' (ጽዮን ቅድስት ዘአስተርአየኒ 'holy Zion, who appeared to me', ch. 56)
glossary.ዘኢነገርከኒ: ነገረ — that you did not tell me (ዘ- relative + ኢ- + 2ms perfect + -ኒ 'me')
glossary.ዘእቀውም: ቆመ — who stand (ዘ- relative + 1cs imperfect, G, q-w-m) · read after ከመ as 'as though I stood' (ከመ ዘእቀውም ውስተ ቀመራ 'as though I stood in the ቀመራ (?)', ch. 56)
glossary.ዘእንበለ: ዘእንበለ — without, except (preposition) · conjunction 'without' + jussive (ዘእንበለ ይስቅይዋ 'without their watering her') · conjunction + perfect 'without (its having been done)' (ዘእንበለ ተሀበኒ ትእምርተ 'without a sign having been given me') · 'except' (ዘእንበለ ዘተሐምም 'except what she suffered')
glossary.ዘከመዝ: ዘከመዝ — such, thus, in this way (ዘ- + ከመ + ዝ)
glossary.ዘይጥሕር: ጠሐረ — which roars (?) (ዘ- relative + 3ms imperfect; stem uncertain) (?)
glossary.ዘገብሩ: ገብረ — which they made (ዘ- relative + 3mp perfect, g-b-r)
glossary.ያስተፉንውዎሙ: አስተፈነወ — they escort, send off (?) (3mp imperfect, causative-reflexive of ፈነወ + -ዎሙ 'them') (?)
glossary.ይሴብሑ: ሰብሐ — they praise (3mp imperfect, G; ይሴብሑ)
glossary.ይቴክዝ: ተከዘ — he is troubled, grieves (3ms imperfect, tä-stem)
glossary.ይትሀወክ: ተሀወከ — it is shaken (3ms imperfect, tä-stem of ሀወከ)
glossary.ይትበተኩ: ተበተከ — they are shattered (?) (3mp imperfect, tä-stem; stem uncertain) (?)
glossary.ይትዐወቁ: ተዐወቀ — they are known (3mp imperfect, tä-stem of ዐወቀ)
glossary.ይእቲ: ይእቲ — she/it is (fem. pron.) · 'I am she' predicate (አነ ይእቲ አቡከ 'I am she, your father')
glossary.ይወፅኡ: ወጽአ — they come out (3mp imperfect, G)
glossary.ይዘብጦን: ዘብጠ — it strikes them (3ms imperfect + -ን 'them', f.pl.)
glossary.ይደነግፁ: ደንገፀ — they are terrified, tremble (3mp imperfect, G)
glossary.ይድፍኑ: ደፈነ — that they cover, shut in (3mp subjunctive/jussive, G, after ፈቀዱ 'they wished')
glossary.ይጠፍሑ: ጠፍሐ — they spread out (3mp imperfect, G, ṭ-f-ḥ; as ወይጠፍሑ 'and they stretch out' in ch. 53)
glossary.ደማስቆ: ደማስቆ — Damascus (proper name; genitive after construct)
glossary.ደቂቀ: ደቂቅ — sons, children (plural ደቂቅ, construct 'sons of')
glossary.ደወለ: ደወል — boundary, border (noun; construct/accusative 'boundary of'; uncertain)
glossary.ዳግመ: ዳግም — again, a second time (adverb, accusative form in -a)
glossary.ገብአ: ገብአ — he returned (3ms perfect, G, g-b-ʾ)
glossary.ግብአተ: ግብአት — return (noun, verbal noun of ገብአ; construct 'return of')
glossary.ግብጽ: ግብጽ — Egypt (proper name; genitive after construct)
glossary.ጠግዐ: ጠግዐ — congealed, stood firm (?) (3ms perfect; sense uncertain) (?)
glossary.ጣዖታቲሆሙ: ጣዖት — their idols (noun, plural ጣዖታት + -ሆሙ '3mp their')
glossary.ጥዩቀ: ጥዩቅ — certain, exact; 'certainly' (adjective, accusative/adverbial form in -a)
glossary.ጸዐኑ: ጸዐነ — they loaded (3mp perfect, G, as ወጸዐኑ in ch. 51–52); 'mounted' is possible (?)
glossary.ፍሥሓ: ፍሥሓ — joy (construct 'joy of') · also the plain accusative 'joy' with an adjective (ኀብሩ ፍሥሓ ዐቢየ 'they joined in great joy')
glossary.፫: ፫ — 3, spoken ሠለስቱ (śälästu) 'three'; chapter number (numeral) · also a counted number 'three' (መጠነ ፫ እመት 'to the measure of three cubits'; ፫ ልብስ 'three garments'); spoken ሠለስ (śäläs) (?) before a feminine noun such as እመት, ሠለስቱ with a masculine
glossary.፶፭: ፶፭ — 55, spoken ኀምሳ ወኀምስቱ (ḫämsa wä-ḫaməstu) 'fifty-five' (numeral; chapter number)
glossary.፶፮: ፶፮ — 56, spoken ኀምሳ ወስድስቱ (ḫämsa wä-sədstu) 'fifty-six' (numeral; chapter number)
